name: Inujima Island
description: The smallest of the Benesse Art Site islands, home to the Inujima Seirensho Art Museum — a former copper refinery transformed into a site-specific art complex.
notes: Ferry from Okayama's Hoden port (~20 min) or Takamatsu; museum admission ¥2,100 (combined tickets available).
reservation: Museum entry: online advance tickets required (¥2,100); island access is walk-in
